# Security policy

## Supported version

Only the latest deployment from `main` receives security updates. Older local copies and preview builds are unsupported.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Please email **nhhoang130803@gmail.com** with the subject `HH Platform security report` before publishing details. Include the affected URL, time (with timezone), request ID from the `X-Request-ID` response header, reproducible steps, impact, and a safe proof of concept.

Do not include passwords, access tokens, private user data, destructive payloads, or data belonging to another person. Do not perform denial-of-service tests, automated account takeover, social engineering, spam, persistence, or public disclosure before remediation.

The project owner should acknowledge a complete report within 72 hours, triage severity, preserve evidence, and coordinate a safe remediation and disclosure timeline. This policy does not promise a bounty or authorize activity prohibited by law.
